Week 5 of 52 - Month 2: Keto adaptation 1: settle in
Focus: Aerobic, tendon-safe, cadence for the fast-legs feel

Warm-up: 5 min brisk walk (3.5-3.8 mph), 1% incline. 20 slow calf raises off the back of the treadmill, 10 leg swings each way.
Main: 6 x (1:30 jog / 2:00 walk). Reps 5 and 6 at 180 steps per minute (fast feet, same speed). Total jog time 9:00.
Cool-down: 5 min walk, then the 15-minute prehab routine (Achilles and Knee Prehab Guide). Heel drops first.

Pain scale 0 = no pain, 10 = worst pain; write it in the planner note.

Week 5 of 52 - Month 2: Keto adaptation 1: settle in
Focus: Movement quality, tendon loading, core

Goblet squat: 3 x 10 at 70 lb (Week 8 target 75 lb). Heels down, knees over toes, depth only as far as pain-free
Dumbbell Romanian deadlift: 3 x 10 at 55 lb (Week 8 target 60 lb). Soft knees, hinge at the hip, flat back
Push-up, or dumbbell floor press if the shoulder objects: 3 x 10. Pain-free only. Body in one line, elbows at 45 degrees
Single-arm dumbbell row: 3 x 10 each at 70-75 lb. Pull the elbow to the hip, no torso twist. Rows are the safe direction for the shoulder
Low box jump or step-up: 3 x 8. Soft, quiet landings. Skip the jump on any day the Achilles is above 2/10

Eccentric heel drops, straight and bent knee: 3 x 12-15 each at 90 lb. Slow 3 s lowering. This is the most important exercise in the session

Notes: Warm up 5 min easy, then 10 bodyweight squats, 10 hinges, 10 arm circles. Rest 60-90 s. Fasted is fine at this length. Week 5: hold the Oct 8 loads. Push-ups only if the shoulder is at 0-1/10.

description:
Week 5 of 52 - Month 2: Keto adaptation 1: settle in
Focus: Glute medius, patellar tracking, trunk stability. Now on its own day, no run before it.

Machine glute thrust (replaces glute bridge): 3 x 10 starting at 150 lb. Your Sep 20 top was 250 lb; start light and leave 3 reps in reserve, add 10-20 lb per week
Clamshell with band: 3 x 15 each. Pelvis does not roll back
Monster walk: 3 x 10 steps each way. Stay low, knees out
Step-down from low step: 3 x 12 each. Knee over second toe, slow. Watch the knee the next morning
Wall sit: 3 x 30 s. Progress time, not depth
Bent-knee calf raise (seated, weight on thigh): 3 x 15 at 90 lb (Week 8 target 100 lb). Slow up, slow down
Bird dog: 3 x 10 each side. Hips level, reach long
Pallof press (band): 3 x 10 each side. Resist the rotation
Front plank: 3 x 30 s. Squeeze glutes, breathe. Count 10-second blocks out loud
Single-leg balance: 3 x 30 s each. Eyes closed if easy

Notes: Warm up 5 min walk or easy spin. First week with the machine glute thrust: 150 lb, 3 reps in reserve.
